Use case: stylized-concept. Soul of Meal production head-and-torso portrait atlas, exactly TWO columns TWO rows, four equal square images, no gutters or text. References 1–4 are the corresponding character identities and costume guides; preserve all four, draw ONE character per cell. Top left Cốm Làng Vòng: pale mint quadruped qilin's catlike face, paired golden grain antlers, tiny white flowers, lotus-leaf mantle and bronze bell, gentle curious expression, jade rice-field and old Hà Nội courtyard background. Top right Cà phê trứng: cream/brown civet, round bronze spectacles, ivory coat, brown waistcoat, brass phin-topped staff visible beside face, thoughtful smile, warm old Hà Nội coffee-house background. Bottom left Thịt kho trứng: amber-brown turtle, rounded brown shell, cream-yellow egg chest medallion and red tassel, bronze bracers, reassuring grin, warm family Tết kitchen background. Bottom right Chả rươi: russet squirrel, big curled orange tail, orange scarf, maple leaf shoulder cape, brown leather/olive tunic, compact bronze round buckler, lively confident expression, soft autumn leaves background.
Polished richly painted original Vietnamese cuisine fantasy anime chibi artwork matching the reference sprites. Each face and identifying accessories clearly readable in 512px square and small thumbnail. Keep backgrounds darker and quieter than faces, cohesive golden jade lighting, distinct compositional gestures. No food photographs, other people, UI, frames, logos, letters, labels or watermarks. No transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent combat VFX atlas for Soul of Meal. Exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows of equal square cells, portrait 3:4 layout, 12 isolated VFX shapes with clean RGBA transparency. No character bodies, labels, grid, text or scenery.
Columns are sequential phases: 1 GATHER, 2 IMPACT, 3 FINISHER/dissipation. Rows have truly different silhouettes and visual language:
Row1 Cốm Làng Vòng: gather two slender green rice stems and small gold grains; impact a compact open canopy of curved lotus leaves with two golden grain ears and three small shield glints; finisher three falling grain diamonds over one low leaf arc. Pale green, jade and warm gold. Preserve open negative space, no opaque disk.
Row2 Cà phê trứng: gather a thin bronze coffee-phin rim with three tiny suspended cream droplets; impact one elegant cream-and-coffee whirl rising from a stylized brass phin contour, with three distinct rhythmic beat marks; finisher three cream drops dissolving into one curling coffee-brown ribbon. Amber, ivory and deep coffee. This is not a recolored magic circle.
Row3 Thịt kho trứng: gather a small white oval egg seal around a gold center; impact TWO curved amber shell-like protective panels flanking one luminous oval egg medallion, with a low caramel wave; finisher a low settling amber wave with three little bronze shield tiles. Golden cream and copper-red. Avoid square leaf shields, turtle body or giant aura.
Row4 Chả rươi: gather one sharp maple leaf with thin curved blade-shaped arc; impact a SINGLE diagonal russet-orange leaf crescent with clear pointed maple-leaf notches and two tiny trailing leaves; finisher two downward spinning autumn leaves with a short broken slash trail. Orange, copper and russet. No full-screen fireball, no X cross or generic ring.
Style: high-quality hand-painted cel-shaded game VFX, controlled soft edge light, strong readable contour, limited bloom. Every complete effect remains within central 65% of its square cell with at least 15% EMPTY transparent margin on ALL sides; never cross cell boundaries, no touching neighbors. No frames, cast shadows, background or large opaque fill.
